name.ja: Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正
name.en: Strang splitting: Dirichlet boundary order reduction and correction

caption.ja: 実1D非周期場で、未補正/境界補正Strangを同じFD参照へ比較し、時間誤差と空間誤差を分けます。 保存済みの数値場と参照を用いた図です。
caption.en: Evolve actual one-dimensional nonperiodic fields and compare unmodified and boundary-corrected Strang splitting against the same spatial discretization. This preview reads saved numerical fields and references only.

name.ja: 非同次境界を持つ線形反応拡散

note.ja: 同じ非周期有限差分系に対する時間誤差と、連続厳密解に対する空間誤差を分けます。
note.en: Separate temporal errors relative to the same nonperiodic finite-difference system from spatial errors relative to the continuous exact family.

note.ja: 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。
note.en: A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries.

equation_note.ja: u_t=u_xx+u、[0,1]、両端u=1、解析定常解+.1正弦摂動、T=.1。内部31/63/127点・8/16/32/64刻みとLie対照4run、計28run。
equation_note.en: Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs.

title.ja: Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正
title.en: Strang splitting: Dirichlet boundary order reduction and correction

references.formula: u_t=u_{xx}+u,\quad u(0,t)=u(1,t)=1,\quad w=u-1;\quad A_{\rm raw}(w)=L_hw,\ B_{\rm raw}(w)=w+1;\quad A_{\rm corr}(w)=L_hw+1,\ B_{\rm corr}(w)=w

assumptions.ja: u_t=u_xx+u、[0,1]、両端u=1、解析定常解+.1正弦摂動、T=.1。内部31/63/127点・8/16/32/64刻みとLie対照4run、計28run。
assumptions.en: Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs.

note.ja: 原著の線形特殊例で非線形数値表の再現ではありません。非自律/一般境界や普遍的な次数低下は主張せず、Lie終端の反応trace不整合も別表示します。
note.en: This is an authored linear specialization, not a reproduction of the original nonlinear tables. It makes no general claim for nonautonomous boundaries or universal order loss. The final reaction-trace mismatch of Lie splitting is disclosed separately.

reference_note.ja: 独立疎affine指数作用と別記述の正弦和を先に資格。同FD時間誤差・解析連続解との差・固定格子/刻み領域の観測次数を判定。
reference_note.en: First qualify an independent sparse affine exponential action against separately written sine sums. Then separate temporal error against the same finite-difference system, spatial error against the analytic continuum field, and observed order in the fixed regime.

method_note.ja: w=u−1で未補正(Lw,w+1)、補正(Lw+1,w)に分割。実DirichletDST-I指数流を合成し、反応の境界不整合を保持します。
method_note.en: For w = u - 1, use the unmodified split (Lw, w + 1) or the corrected split (Lw + 1, w). Compose actual Dirichlet DST-I flows and retain the reaction boundary mismatch.
